initial_sql: WITH region_category_sales AS (SELECT o.region, c.name AS category_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.subtotal), 2) AS total_sales FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-08-14' AND '2026-09-12' AND o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.region, c.id), region_avg AS (SELECT region, AVG(total_sales) AS avg_sales FROM region_category_sales GROUP BY region) SELECT rcs.region, rcs.category_name, rcs.total_sales FROM region_category_sales rcs JOIN region_avg ra ON rcs.region = ra.region WHERE rcs.total_sales > 30000 AND rcs.total_sales > ra.avg_sales ORDER BY rcs.total_sales DESC LIMIT 10
final_sql: WITH region_category_sales AS (SELECT o.region, c.name AS category_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.subtotal), 2) AS total_sales FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-08-14' AND '2026-09-12' AND o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.region, c.id), region_avg AS (SELECT region, AVG(total_sales) AS avg_sales FROM region_category_sales GROUP BY region) SELECT rcs.region, rcs.category_name, rcs.total_sales FROM region_category_sales rcs JOIN region_avg ra ON rcs.region = ra.region WHERE rcs.total_sales > 30000 AND rcs.total_sales > ra.avg_sales ORDER BY rcs.total_sales DESC LIMIT 10

initial_sql: WITH monthly_sales AS (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS month, ROUND(SUM(oi.subtotal), 2) AS total_sales FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY month), monthly_with_growth AS (SELECT month, total_sales, LAG(total_sales) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_month_sales, CASE WHEN LAG(total_sales) OVER (ORDER BY month) IS NULL OR LAG(total_sales) OVER (ORDER BY month) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND((total_sales - LAG(total_sales) OVER (ORDER BY month)) * 100.0 / LAG(total_sales) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) END AS growth_rate FROM monthly_sales) SELECT month, total_sales, growth_rate FROM monthly_with_growth WHERE growth_rate IS NOT NULL ORDER BY growth_rate DESC LIMIT 3

initial_sql: WITH region_stats AS (SELECT o.region, ROUND(SUM(oi.subtotal), 2) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS order_count FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' AND strftime('%Y', o.order_date) = '2025' GROUP BY o.region), national_avg AS (SELECT AVG(total_sales) AS avg_sales, AVG(order_count) AS avg_orders FROM region_stats) SELECT rs.region, rs.total_sales, rs.order_count FROM region_stats rs, national_avg na WHERE rs.total_sales > na.avg_sales AND rs.order_count > na.avg_orders ORDER BY rs.total_sales DESC

initial_sql: WITH product_sales AS (SELECT p.category_id, p.name AS product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_sold FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY p.id, p.category_id HAVING SUM(oi.quantity) > 50), ranked_products AS (SELECT ps.category_id, ps.product_name, ps.total_sold, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ps.category_id ORDER BY ps.total_sold DESC) AS rn FROM product_sales ps) SELECT c.name AS category_name, rp.product_name, rp.total_sold FROM ranked_products rp JOIN categories c ON c.id = rp.category_id WHERE rp.rn <= 3 ORDER BY c.name, rp.total_sold DESC

initial_sql: WITH region_sales AS ( SELECT o.region, SUM(oi.subtotal) AS total_sales FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.region ), region_appliance_sales AS ( SELECT o.region, SUM(oi.subtotal) AS appliance_sales FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' AND c.name = '家用电器' GROUP BY o.region ), platform_appliance_ratio AS ( SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN c.name = '家用电器' THEN oi.subtotal ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(oi.subtotal) AS platform_ratio FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' ) SELECT ras.region, ROUND(ras.appliance_sales, 2) AS appliance_sales, ROUND(ras.appliance_sales * 100.0 / rs.total_sales, 2) AS region_appliance_ratio_pct FROM region_appliance_sales ras JOIN region_sales rs ON ras.region = rs.region CROSS JOIN platform_appliance_ratio par WHERE ras.appliance_sales * 100.0 / rs.total_sales > par.platform_ratio ORDER BY region_appliance_ratio_pct DESC
